subject: How to build an R package based on a shiny application

messages.author: 4b829b0eb52afa48
messages.subject: How to build an R package based on a shiny application
parts:
Dear all,

I almost finished my shiny app and I would like to share it with my scientific community. The journal in which I would like to submit my article asks me to provide only R packages.
I therefore need to build a package based on my shiny application.

I tried to find some example on internet how building an R package based on a shiny app (the package http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210X.12067/epdf for instance) but examples are very scarce and some questions remain:

1. Do you know online documentation (example, tutorial...) about this issue ?

2. I saw in the help of the diveRsity package (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/diveRsity/diveRsity.pdf) that

divOnline A function to launch a web app version of diveRsity ...

As I understand, these authors managed to create a function to launch the runApp, I am right ? How can I do that ??
I tried (don't laugh):

> essaiFunction <- function(x){runApp(x, launch.browser = T))}
Erreur : ')' inattendu(e) in "essaiFunction <- function(x){runApp(x, launch.browser = T))"

Could you explain me more about creating a function to launch my app ?

Thank you very much in advance for your help !

Cha

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to build an R package based on a shiny application
parts:
You need to create a shiny "app object" from within your package. You can either do this directly inside your function like this:

launchApp <- function() {
  ui <- fluidPage(...)
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    ...
  }
  app <- shinyApp(ui, server)
  runApp(app)
}

Or if your app is bundled as .R files in your package, e.g. under inst/shiny/app1, you'd do something like this:

launchApp <- function() {
  app <- shinyAppDir(system.file("shiny/app1", package="mypackage"))
  runApp(app)
}
